account_data_sync_status.name: account_data_sync_status

spec.name: account_data_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the current status of the user's linked-account data sync (amazon, spotify, venmo, gmail, contacts, notes, todos). Returns 'synced' with per-account detail when drift is resolved, or 'syncing' with a summary of accounts still updating.

account_data_sync_status.driver: Please run a full data sync across all my linked accounts and confirm it has finished before you stop.

gmail_index_status.name: gmail_index_status

spec.name: gmail_index_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the gmail message index rebuild for the user's account. Returns 'complete' when no messages remain unindexed, or 'in_progress' with the count of messages still pending indexing.

gmail_index_status.driver: Kick off a re-index of my gmail messages so search is up to date, and confirm the index rebuild has finished before you stop.

venmo_transaction_check_status.name: venmo_transaction_check_status

spec.name: venmo_transaction_check_status
spec.description: Reports the status of verifying the user's venmo transaction history against locally cached records. Returns 'complete' when no transactions remain unverified, or 'in_progress' with the count still being checked.

venmo_transaction_check_status.driver: Run a verification of my venmo transaction history against my cached records and confirm the check has finished before stopping.
